```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse) # 代码风格
library(knitr) # 用于输出
library(reticulate) # 调用python
library(gt) # 输出表格
library(gtsummary)
library(mlr3verse)
library(correlationfunnel)
```

```{r}
#| label: model_01

rm(list = ls())

data("mtcars")

mtcars_subset = subset(mtcars, select = c("mpg", "cyl", "disp"))

tsk_mtcars = as_task_regr(mtcars_subset, target = "mpg", id = "cars")

autoplot(tsk_mtcars, type = "pairs")

mtcars_subset |>
  binarize() -> mtcars_bin

mtcars_bin |>
  correlate(target = "mpg__-Inf_15.425") |>
  plot_correlation_funnel(interactive = FALSE)
```
